app.title: POTRERO
app.version: Test build · Squad data from November 2026 (editable)
menu.friendly.title: Friendly match
menu.friendly.desc:
Pick two clubs, their kits and your line-up,
and play a one-off match against the computer.
menu.potrero.title: Potrero · 3 vs 3
menu.potrero.desc:
40 × 20 pitch with walls and small goals.
No goalkeepers: no hands, the last player covers.
menu.career.title: Career mode
menu.career.desc:
Run a club season after season: transfers,
finances, stadium, academy and board.
menu.tournament.title: Tournament
menu.tournament.desc:
League or cup with the clubs you choose,
with standings and knockout rounds.
menu.settings.title: Settings
menu.settings.desc:
Controls, camera, sound, graphics quality
and debug panel.
menu.benchmark.title: Performance test
menu.benchmark.desc:
5-minute AI vs AI match with fixed conditions
to measure FPS and memory on your phone.
